_readme: Card panels whose highlight is a region grown on the parent bone, not the
atlas object the mapping names. Read by renderMusclePanels.py --regions.
Rules are landmarkRegions.py rules (same kinds as landmark-regions.rules.json);

rule._why: The lateral malleolus is the distal end of the fibula. The atlas's own 'Lateral malleolus' object is a flat marker disc beside the bone.
The medial malleolus is the process of the tibia that hangs below the plafond; the lowest slab of the tibia is it.

The posterior end of the calcaneus, where the Achilles tendon inserts. Added 18 Oct 2026 for the Atlas card; the spec's anchor sits off the bone (renders/landmarks-render.log), so the region is grown on the bone instead.

The blade of C7's spinous process, the posterior 20mm (the lumbar spinous-process rule measured 18mm). Added 18 Oct 2026 for the Atlas card; the spec's anchor sits off the bone (renders/landmarks-render.log), so the region is grown on the bone instead.

The forked tips of the cervical spinous processes, C2 to C6 (owner: the other cervical vertebrae have one too; C7's is usually single and long, its own landmark). The posterior 12mm of each. Added 18 Oct 2026 for the Atlas card; the spec's anchor sits off the bone (renders/landmarks-render.log), so the region is grown on the bone instead.

The notch in the upper border of the manubrium, between the clavicular notches: the top 12mm, central 22mm only (8mm by 15mm was too small to see at a whole-chest framing). Added 18 Oct 2026 for the Atlas card; the spec's anchor sits off the bone (renders/landmarks-render.log), so the region is grown on the bone instead.

The medial tuberosity of the navicular: the whole bone, cut to its medial 12mm (the medial-malleolus trick). Added 18 Oct 2026 for the Atlas card; the spec's anchor sits off the bone (renders/landmarks-render.log), so the region is grown on the bone instead.

The proximal (posterior) 15mm of the fifth metatarsal, with its tuberosity. Added 18 Oct 2026 for the Atlas card; the spec's anchor sits off the bone (renders/landmarks-render.log), so the region is grown on the bone instead.

The proximal 12mm of the first metacarpal, at the saddle joint with the trapezium. Added 18 Oct 2026 for the Atlas card; the spec's anchor sits off the bone (renders/landmarks-render.log), so the region is grown on the bone instead.

The distal 12mm of the first metacarpal; the landmark route's rule aims at an anchor the panel route does not have. Added 18 Oct 2026 for the Atlas card; the spec's anchor sits off the bone (renders/landmarks-render.log), so the region is grown on the bone instead.

The hook projects palmarward (anterior, palms forward): the most palmar 7mm of the hamate. Added 18 Oct 2026 for the Atlas card; the spec's anchor sits off the bone (renders/landmarks-render.log), so the region is grown on the bone instead.

The tubercle is the scaphoid's palmar, distal, radial prominence: the bone's extreme in that direction on the left hand, mirrored for the right. The atlas's 'Tubercle of scaphoid bone.j' label, snapped to the bone, lands within about 3mm of it. A palmar slab (the first two tries) marked a sliver that wrapped onto the dorsum. Added 19 Oct 2026; point measured in world millimetres with probe_last4.py (+x body left, +y posterior, +z up).

The snuffbox is a space between the tendons of extensor pollicis longus and brevis/abductor pollicis longus, with no object of its own; the picture marks its FLOOR, the radial (lateral), dorsal side of the scaphoid, which is what is palpated in it. Added 19 Oct 2026; point measured in world millimetres with probe_last4.py (+x body left, +y posterior, +z up).

The inferior articular processes hang down behind the body, either side of the spinous process: L4's lowest points more than 10mm from the midline and 15mm behind its centre, both sides. The atlas has no anchor for them. Added 19 Oct 2026; point measured in world millimetres with probe_last4.py (+x body left, +y posterior, +z up).
